parameters.name: DataQualityRules
parameters.description: 数据质量监控关联的数据质量规则列表。如果设置了DataQualityRule.Id，则把Id对应的规则关联到新建质量监控中；如果没有设置，则用其他字段创建一个新的规则，关联到新建的质量监控中。

parameters.name: DataSourceId
parameters.description: 数据源ID，您可以调用[ListDataSources](~~211431~~)获取数据源的ID。

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。

parameters.name: RuntimeConf
parameters.description:
扩展配置，JSON格式的字符串，只对EMR类型的数据质量监控生效。
- queue：执行EMR数据质量校验时，使用的yarn队列，默认为本项目配置的队列
- sqlEngine：执行EMR的数据校验时，采用的SQL引擎
    + HIVE_SQL
    + SPARK_SQL

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.description: 数据质量校验任务的触发配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-quality-evaluation-task --target TableGuid=odps.api_test.ods_openapi_log_d DatabaseType=maxcompute PartitionSpec=pt=_yyyymmdd-1 --description OpenAPI_create_a_data_quality_monitoring_test --name OpenAPI_create_a_data_quality_monitoring_test --runtime-conf queue_:_default_,_sqlEngine_:_SPARK_SQL --trigger '{"Type":"ByScheduledTaskInstance","TaskIds":[30001]}' --project-id 10000 --hooks Condition=severity_==_High_AND_status_==_Critical_OR_severity_==_Normal_AND_status_==_Critical_OR_severity_==_Normal_AND_status_==_Error Type=BlockTaskInstance --notifications '{"Condition":"severity_==_High_AND_status_==_Critical_OR_severity_==_Normal_AND_status_==_Critical_OR_severity_==_Normal_AND_status_==_Error","Notifications":[{"NotificationChannels":[["Mail"]],"NotificationReceivers":[{"Extension":"atAll_:_true","ReceiverType":"DingdingUrl","ReceiverValues":["https://api.fc.aliyuncs.com/webhook"]}]}]}' --data-source-id 1 --data-quality-rules '[{"TemplateCode":"SYSTEM:field:null_value:fixed:0","Description":"OpenAPI_test_rules","CheckingConfig":{"Type":"Fixed","Thresholds":{"Expected":{"Operator":"=","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"0"},"Warned":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"0.001"},"Critical":{"Operator":"example-string","Expression":"checkValue_0.01","Value":"0.01"}},"ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1"},"Enabled":true,"Severity":"High","Id":2176,"SamplingConfig":{"SettingConfig":"odps.sql.type.system.odps2=True,odps.sql.hive.compatible=True","SamplingFilter":"status_!=_Succeeded","Metric":"NullValueCount","MetricParameters":"Columns_:_id_,_name_,_SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table"},"ErrorHandlers":[{"Type":"SaveErrorData","ErrorDataFilter":"SELECT_0_FROM_ods_api_log_WHERE_status_=_Error"}],"Name":"OpenAPI_test_rules"}]' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
